entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: Sphinx planeswalker who invented etherium on Esper and was blamed for the aether-liches.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Alaran shard where etherium is central.

entities.name: Noble Work
entities.description: Project to infuse living things with etherium.

entities.name: Aether-liches
entities.description: Undead abominations created by replacing flesh with etherium.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Dreamt of Crucius while being healed by Bolas; the Seeker.

entities.name: Sharuum
entities.description: Hegemon of Esper, dreamt to be Crucius's lover.

entities.name: Kemuel
entities.description: Dreamt son of Crucius and Sharuum, guardian of the Crystal Labyrinth.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event decades after Crucius devised etherium.

events.summary: Crucius devises etherium and begins the Noble Work.
events.quote: Crucius devised the magical alloy etherium and began a grand project to infuse living things on Esper with it

events.summary: Esperites replace their flesh with etherium creating aether-liches; Crucius is blamed, called the Mad, and disappears.
events.quote: earning him the moniker Crucius the Mad

events.summary: In a fevered vision Tezzeret dreams that Sharuum was Crucius's lover and Kemuel their son, testing Seekers.
events.quote: Tezzeret dreamt that Sharuum , the hegemon of Esper, was Crucius's lover
